result: All three pieces of hardware can be assembled in the revised enclosure corner with their snap covers installed. Derek confirmed the Pisco entry change at the bench.
retention: Derek rates the ASSE tightest and already good enough, the flow meter next and the Pisco loosest. The Pisco cover rocks against the receiver when moved by hand.
hypotheses: Derek attributes the play to the mating chamfers and suggests the supported meter overhang may print thick. The video supplies no displacement measurement.
requested_trial: Compare two progressively tighter Pisco covers on the same Mark2 plate against this enclosure corner.
